C=np.array([0]+[.5]*9+[5]*10); S=np.array([2]+[.5]*9+[3]*10)
ks=[(0,0)]+[(i,5) for i in range(10,20)]
pairs=[(i,j) for i in range(20) for j in range(i+1,20)]
def feat(X):
 Z=(X-C)/S
 h=[np.maximum(X[:,i]-k,0)/S[i] for i,k in ks]
 return np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)),Z]+h+[Z[:,i]*Z[:,j] for i,j in pairs])
A=sample(32000); B=sample(8000); ya=predict(A); yb=predict(B)
F=feat(A); G=feat(B); first=21+len(ks)

order=np.argsort(-np.abs(cf[first:]))
num=60
take=order[:num]; ids=np.r_[np.arange(first),first+take]
coef=np.linalg.lstsq(F[:,ids],ya,rcond=1e-9)[0]
fit=G[:,ids]@coef; er=yb-fit
